text: Post-launch roadmap draft: Nov = OTA updates GA + multi-site scheduling, Dec = custom alerts and Console migration tool. All assumes we ship GA Oct 14.
Big risk to Oct 14: KeyGate's fix for ATL-212 is ETA Oct 9. That leaves almost no buffer for Devon to verify.
Agreed. If KeyGate slips, I'd rather ship Standard tier on Oct 14 and hold Enterprise than move the whole launch again.
Globex only cares about Enterprise, so for them a split launch is still a slip.
Design-wise both paths are ready. Launch comms will need two versions though.
Yep, I'll draft both for the launch comms due Oct 14.
